source: 刘晓燕《四级你还在背单词吗》
title: The Cartoon in the Fishing Town
tts_text: Last summer a film crew came to our town to make a cartoon about the old fishermen. The director wanted to portray their life honestly. Every morning a small band played on the beach, and a gang of children ran after the camera. Even the gulls flocked to the boats. The story was a battle against a beast from the hills. The fishermen had to combat it. They beat drums and hit the water with long poles. The young hero never used a hammer or a punch. He only tied a bandage around the animal's leg, and the beast walked away. In July the town is a quiet resort, and the director was a classic city man from a middle-class family. He liked to classify people by their jobs. With money from the city he also wanted to upgrade the old cinema. One evening there was a long debate, almost a dispute, about the ending. A young editor gave a hint. "Do not just say it," he said. "Demonstrate it. Illustrate it with a short demo." His words seemed to imply a warning, though the warning was only implicit. He was never explicit. "Every picture must convey one feeling," he added. A survey of the town showed that most people wanted the happy ending. So the crew decided to invest the rest of the money in a second episode.

sentences_cn: 去年夏天，一个摄制组来到我们镇上，要拍一部关于老渔民的动画片。
导演想诚实地描绘他们的生活。
每天早上都有一支小乐队在海滩上演奏，一帮孩子追着摄像机跑。
连海鸥都成群地飞向渔船。
故事讲的是与山里一头野兽的战役。
渔民们必须与它搏斗。
他们敲鼓，用长竿打水。
年轻的男主角从没用过锤子，也没挥过拳头。
他只是把一条绷带缠在野兽的腿上，那头野兽就走开了。
七月里小镇是个安静的度假胜地，而导演是个典型的中产阶级出身的城里人。
他喜欢按职业给人分类。
带着城里来的钱，他还想把老电影院升级一下。
一天晚上，关于结局有一场漫长的争论，几乎算得上争吵。
一位年轻剪辑师给了个暗示。
“别只是说出来，”他说。
“要演示出来。用一个短短的样品展示出来。”
他话里似乎暗示着一个警告，尽管那警告只是含蓄的。
他从不明说。
“每一幅画面都必须传达一种情绪，”他补充道。
镇上的一项调查显示，大多数人想要那个圆满结局。
于是剧组决定把剩下的钱投进第二集。
